note: Ratchet baseline for the in-progress board. CI fails the DRC step only if a count RISES above these numbers (regression, or the checker changed behaviour) or if the DRC tool/report itself is broken. Counts at or below the baseline are reported as board state, never as 'DRC passed'. When routing completes (0 violations, 0 unconnected), set both counts to 0: the same step then acts as a hard zero-tolerance DRC gate again, with no code change. CALIBRATION (round 2, 2026-11-03): these numbers are the FIRST TRUE MEASUREMENT of the current board, superseding the round-1 seed (807/175). The seed's recorded provenance was a KiCad 8 run on main @ b5c2b57 — but git shows that tree carried the PRE-v5 board (blob ebe97655), so the seed measured the previous board, not this one. The current board changed exactly once between b5c2b57 and ec773ed: fb2acf7 (router v5 result) replaced hw/pdlvds_rx.kicad_pcb (blob ebe97655 -> 6a377ebc), reaching main via the routing-work merges; both parents of ec773ed carry blob 6a377ebc. The delta direction matches v5's documented trade (stricter clearance model: fewer violations; fewer nets routed, 58/112 vs v4's 67/112: more unconnected). This is calibration to a first measurement of a changed board — not ratchet-loosening to fit a regression: no count was raised above a same-board measurement, because no same-board measurement existed before run 41750532660.
